rules.rule: Check for mpox exposure, lesion sites and associated symptoms
rules.problem: Triggered by any skin lesion/eruption (broad, as a pre-screen should be). 'Unexplained' and the 2-day fever window are not checkable; temperature is a routine vital.

rules.rule: Check for urgent mpox danger signs
rules.problem: Red-box item 'age > 65' is not checked anywhere. 'HIV not on ART' has no checkable form (only known HIV + unsuppressed viral load). The footnote's shock definition (SBP < 80, pulse >= 100, RR > 30, confusion/restlessness, weakness -> 'shock likely') is a 'likely' diagnosis on the page but is not encoded as a probable Shock rule; the box relies on a recorded 'Shock' finding.

rules.rule: Check for proctitis and other causes of rash/lesions in suspected mpox
rules.problem: Covers the non-urgent section and the differential grid. Minor: vesicle stages, rash spread direction and dermatomal band are not checkable (see claims).

rules.rule: Diagnose possible mpox (contact or new lesions with systemic symptoms)
rules.problem: Type (possible) and or/and structure match 'Suspect mpox if contact ... or new lesions and any of'. Fever window and 'in the 21 days before symptom onset' are approximated (c095, c105). The page's 'if lesions all look similar and progress at a similar pace, mpox is more likely' is not encoded; arguably a probable mpox rule.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable dehydration in suspected mpox
rules.problem: Page says 'dehydration likely' so probable is right. The comma list is read as 'or', so thirst alone yields probable dehydration; page is ambiguous on whether the signs are cumulative.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable proctitis in suspected mpox
rules.problem: Both page statements (urgent box severe symptoms; non-urgent 'anal sex and anal bleeding/pain/discharge') are encoded faithfully.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable paraphimosis in suspected mpox
Diagnose probable myocarditis in suspected mpox
rules.problem: Comma list read as 'or', so chest pain alone gives probable myocarditis; page ambiguous (compare 'Eye lesion/s and vision changes' which uses 'and').

rules.rule: Diagnose probable corneal infection in suspected mpox
Diagnose probable chickenpox in suspected mpox
rules.problem: 'At different stages of healing' dropped (c149); generalised + itchy column constraints correctly applied.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable papular pruritic eruption in suspected mpox
Diagnose probable scabies in suspected mpox
Diagnose probable drug-induced rash in suspected mpox
Diagnose probable measles in suspected mpox
rules.problem: Rash spread from face to body dropped (c176). 'Notify' is a management step, correctly not encoded.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable tick bite fever in suspected mpox
rules.problem: 'Rash spreading from extremities to body' is dropped; rule fires on generalised non-itchy rash plus tick bite or eschar.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable molluscum contagiosum in suspected mpox
rules.problem: 'Central dimple' encoded as Skin dimple (c188), a different finding.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable herpes simplex in suspected mpox
rules.problem: 'Especially around mouth or genitals' correctly treated as non-essential.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable hand-foot and mouth disease in suspected mpox
rules.problem: Requires vesicles at mouth, palms and soles (page uses 'and'); perioral site encoded as mouth structure (c201).

rules.rule: Diagnose probable shingles in suspected mpox
Diagnose probable impetigo in suspected mpox
rules.problem: Localised + itchy column constraints correctly applied; honey colour not expressible.

rules.rule: Urgent: suspected mpox with danger signs
rules.problem: Level Urgent matches 'Give urgent attention'. Missing red-box item: 'age > 65' (no age condition at all). The HIV branch requires known HIV AND unsuppressed viral load, so 'HIV not on ART' without a viral load result never triggers urgency. Everything else in the box is present; 'Severe' applied to anal pain/discharge is a reading choice.

summary: The red-box criterion 'age > 65' is absent from both the danger-sign check and the Urgent priority rule, and 'HIV not on ART' is only reachable via an unsuppressed viral load, so two page-stated urgent groups are silently dropped. The footnote's 'shock likely' criteria are not encoded as a probable diagnosis, and the fever criterion loses its 2-day window. The rest of the page is encoded faithfully; remaining issues are concept precision (perioral vs mouth, skin dimple for umbilication, lesion of face vs skin of face, acute confusion, obstipation) and dropped descriptive qualifiers (vesicle stages, rash spread, dermatomal band).
